findings.title_text: Bank payment by a non-account-payee instrument over the s.40A(3) limit on 2025-06-01
limits_text: The instrument is inferred from the bank narration only; the cheque itself or the bank's paid-cheque record shows whether it was crossed account payee.
Rule 6DD exceptions are not visible from the books; wages have no general exception.
Rows are per payment: sub-limit payments to the same person on the same day are not joined, so this list can understate, never overstate, the payments over the limit.
ask_client_text: Provide the cheque (or the bank's paid-cheque image) for this payment and name the payee.
State whether any Rule 6DD exception applies, with the supporting record.
